'''Kasstroff''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was among the small contingent of soldiers who were sent by the Empire to infiltrate the Republic capital of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] itself. In [[The Works/Legends|the Works]] section of the [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] Kasstroff met with a notorious thief [[Skavak/Legends|Skavak]], who delivered to him the prized [[Murustavan Ruby]]. The meeting was interrupted by [[Miel Muwn]], [[Corso Riggs]] and [[Voidhound]] and in the ensuing firefight Kasstroff fatally wounded Muwn, before being killed himself. Only then did the Voidhound find out that the Ruby was faked all along and the deaths had been for nothing.<ref name="Race the Devil" />
